courses.overview: 從影像物理、卷積架構與檢測誤差延伸至兩個相近領域；共用架構不代表相同數值、許可權或安全保證。
courses.overviewEn: Extend image physics, convolutional architectures and detection errors to two neighboring areas; shared architectures do not imply equal values, privileges or guarantees.

related.title: 模型監測與漂移偵測
related.why: 共同監測分佈和群組質量
related.whyEn: Both monitor distributions and group quality
related.transfer: 共同監測分佈和群組質量
related.transferEn: Both monitor distributions and group quality
related.difference: 視覺還依賴成像與幾何校正
related.differenceEn: Vision additionally depends on imaging and geometry

place.name: NIST 研究城市代表點
place.coordinateScope: 城市中心近似座標，僅作公開技術脈絡的地理代表點，不是機構地址、裝置位置、登入位置或參訪入口。研究與開源合作分散全球，並非本課所有技術都在此發明或部署。
place.coordinateScopeEn: Approximate city-center coordinates for public technical context, not institutional addresses, equipment, login locations or visitor entrances. Research and open collaboration are global; this does not locate every invention or deployment.

practice: 畫出本課與「模型監測與漂移偵測」共用的資料／元件介面；以「共同監測分佈和群組質量」指出能保留的條件。
針對「視覺還依賴成像與幾何校正」改寫一個實驗，列出新增的輸入、單位與可辨別觀測。
將本課量化例移到新情境：沿用有根據的公式、重新指定假設並標記不能移轉的數值。
practiceEn: Draw shared data/component interfaces with model monitoring and drift detection; use "Both monitor distributions and group quality" to identify retained conditions.
For "Vision additionally depends on imaging and geometry", redesign one experiment with new inputs, units and discriminating observations.
Transfer the quantitative example: retain justified formulas, respecify assumptions and identify nontransferable values.

related.title: 三維渲染引擎
related.why: 共同處理座標、取樣與圖形管線
related.whyEn: Both handle coordinates, sampling and image pipelines
related.transfer: 共同處理座標、取樣與圖形管線
related.transferEn: Both handle coordinates, sampling and image pipelines
related.difference: 視覺從影像推斷，渲染從模型生成影像
related.differenceEn: Vision infers from images; rendering generates them

courses.summary: 機器視覺檢測系統從影像物理、卷積架構與檢測誤差連結介面、資料與驗收。地圖是公開研究城市的近似代表點，不代表所有工具在此製造或部署。
courses.summaryEn: Machine-vision inspection systems connects interfaces, data and acceptance through image physics, convolutional architectures and detection errors. Maps are approximate public research-city references, not claims of manufacturing or deployment.
courses.connection: 從「光學取樣」到「工程驗收」，將技術定義與可反駁驗證對接。
courses.connectionEn: Connect optical sampling to engineering acceptance, pairing technical definitions and falsifiable validation.

history.title: 從公開架構到原創教學模型
history.titleEn: From public architecture to original teaching models
history.text: 卷積與注意力架構連線成像物理和檢驗任務；課題用自製圖形，不將網路準確率當生產安全證明。
history.textEn: Convolution and attention connect imaging physics with inspection; self-made shapes do not make network accuracy a production-safety guarantee.

history.year: 科教與協作 / Education and collaboration
history.title: 跨機構、跨版本的工程驗證
history.titleEn: Engineering checks across institutions and versions
history.text: 本課由原始檔案與官方介面出發，使用自製架構、算例和合成資料；城市標記只協助理解協作脈絡，不聲稱可參訪、可登入或具有現場操作許可權。
history.textEn: The course starts from original documents and official interfaces, using original architectures, examples and synthetic data. City markers provide collaboration context, not visits, logins or operational privileges.
